title: spec(datasource): SqliteConfigSchema.filename accepts a ':memory:/…' value, so the build door and the datasource metadata write store a database that cannot open
body:
domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location. Owed by PR #30395 (#30331, server half), which refuses the value at the datasource admin doors and records the spec refinement as `follow-up owed`. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4 for the spec lane. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2. ⛔ Serial after PR #30395 merges: reuse its classifier rather than writing a second one.

## What happens

`packages/spec/src/data/driver/sqlite.zod.ts` types `SqliteConfigSchema.filename` as any placeholder-free string. A value that starts with `:` but is not exactly `:memory:` (for example `:memory:/tmp/x/parts.db`, which Setup's datasource dialog produces when a person types into the prefilled `:memory:`) passes the schema. Each layer then treats it as "no file":

- native `better-sqlite3` opens a relative path in a directory that does not exist, so every statement fails;
- `sqlite-wasm` opens a throwaway in-memory database, so writes vanish on reconnect.

After PR #30395, `POST /api/v1/datasources/test` and the datasource admin create and update refuse such a value with a message that says why. Two doors still accept it, because they validate against the spec schema alone:

- the build door, a datasource declared in an app's source;
- `PUT /api/v1/meta/datasource/:name`.

## Ask

Refine `filename` so that a value starting with `:` is accepted only when it is exactly `:memory:`, with an error message that names the value and says why. Use the same rule PR #30395 applies at the admin doors (its `sqlite-database-filename.ts`), so there is one definition. Decide whether "usable path" (the directory exists or can be created) belongs in the schema or stays a runtime check; the schema cannot touch the file system.

Expected declarations: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`.

Reader who acts: `domain:spec`, `packages/spec/src/data/driver/sqlite.zod.ts`.

Dedupe: `SqliteConfigSchema filename memory`, `sqlite filename colon prefix`. **New.**
